hints.title: Root Minimum Value
hints.text: The root value is guaranteed to be the overall minimum value of the entire tree.

hints.title: Branch Pruning
hints.text: If a child node has a value strictly greater than the root, that child is a candidate for the second minimum, so its subtrees do not need to be traversed further.

hints.title: Subproblem Traversal
hints.text: Traverse down branches where node values equal the root. For branches with strictly greater values, take the value directly. Return the minimum of valid candidate values found in left and right subtrees.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: DFS traversal pruning subtrees once a value greater than the root is found.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Collecting all tree nodes into an array without pruning incurs full tree traversal and sorting overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Pruning branches with values strictly exceeding the root bounds recursion depth to tree height.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Exploit the special tree property where node.val equals the minimum of its children.
